newsitem.title: USA: Lauder family files to sell some Estee shrs.
newsitem.headline: Lauder family files to sell some Estee shrs.

text.p: Estee Lauder Cos Inc said it would file Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 5,665,000 shares of Class A common being sold by certain members of the Lauder family.
After the offering, the family will beneficially own 79.3 percent of the company's outstanding shares and will have 96.1 percent of the combined voting power of common stock.
The company intends to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 849,750 additional Class A shares to cover over-allotments.
